_help: Fill in your PC's local IP so you can open workflow forms from your phone or tablet.
_tip_ip: Find your IP: open Command Prompt → type 'ipconfig' → look for IPv4 Address (e.g. 192.168.1.10)
_tip_port: Leave port as 5679 unless you changed it in .env
_workflows_help: These are the form URLs for each workflow. Bookmark links.html to open them fast.
_tip_telegram: Set to false if you don't want the daily status page sent to Telegram
